entities.name: Yoʻldosh Aʼzamov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yoʻldosh Aʼzamov was an Uzbek actor, film director, playwright, screenwriter, and film producer. He is best known for his films Maftuningman (1958) and Oʻtgan kunlar (1967). Maftuningman is the first Uzbek comedy and is considered to be one of the greatest Uzbek films of all time.
